answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in mesa, verified in plume, and terrace names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 396 aliases cost 394 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
